name: NOCTRA AI
headline: Your Personal AI Space.
shortDescription: A privacy-first AI chat application for Android. Connect your preferred OpenAI-compatible providers, manage conversations locally, and interact with AI on your own terms.
overview: Built with Flutter and Dart in a clean local-first architecture, NOCTRA AI connects directly from your Android device to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint—whether cloud APIs or self-hosted models via Ollama and LM Studio—without developer accounts or telemetry.

features.title: OpenAI-Compatible APIs
features.description: Connect directly to POST /chat/completions and GET /models endpoints across cloud or local inference servers.

features.title: Custom Model Configuration
features.description: Configure base URLs, model identifiers, system prompts, and custom parameters per provider or conversation.

features.title: Multiple AI Providers
features.description: Switch effortlessly between configured providers, test connectivity before saving, and assign defaults.

features.title: Local Conversation Storage
features.description: Conversations, messages, personas, and prompt templates stay on-device in Hive storage with JSON/Markdown export.

features.title: Secure API Key Storage
features.description: Credentials are stored exclusively in Android Keystore-backed encrypted storage—never in plain text or exported backups.

features.title: Image & Document Attachments
features.description: Extract and inspect PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, TXT, MD, JSON, CSV, and image files locally on your device before transmission.

features.title: Streaming AI Responses
features.description: Real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) token streaming with Markdown, syntax-highlighted code blocks, and LaTeX math rendering.

features.title: Dark & AMOLED Interface
features.description: Designed around a deep obsidian palette (#090B10) with optional true-black AMOLED mode and biometric app lock.

privacyControls: Zero analytics SDKs, crash-reporting uploaders, or advertising trackers
No mandatory user account or developer-operated relay server
Android Keystore-backed API key storage with automatic secret redaction on export
Granular transmission controls for prior chat history and attachments
Optional biometric lock gate and local auto-deletion / full data wipe
transmissionNotice: When you send a prompt or include an attachment, NOCTRA AI transmits that request directly from your device to the external or local AI provider endpoint you configured, subject to that provider's terms and privacy policy.
